The Fifth Crusade was a time of change for Minagho. She went from being Baphomet's "trusted" general to a failure. She ran from her inevitable fate only to be convinced to reject her very nature. Finally, she joined the Commander in ascending.
Uncertain as to her desires and goals, Minagho found herself needing to establish her divine portfolio to her initial followers. She sought to provide blessings for deception and beguilement to protect another. Her church struggled in its early years as her reputation attracted many seeking to deceive for their own benefit and as she struggled against her old instincts.

Rather, she focused all of her attention on the Commander's cult that she had led. She instructed them to join the Commander's new church and to help guide the new congregation.

She found herself drawn into the internal politics of the nascent church as factions fighting to establish the identity of the church sought to use her status as a demon redeemed by the Commander to bolster their positions. Seeing through the charades, she used her skills to root out any grifters or con men seeking to exploit the Commander's name while supporting those that believed in the Commander's ideals.

In time she offered to teach the celestials the tricks used by demons to help them better spot and resist them.

During the time she had spent with the mortals, she witnessed aspects of them that she had never had to deal with before, and she questioned her role in the Abyss. While fully capable of returning and making a life on some new layer, she decided to stay in the mortal world instead as she tried to understand both herself and mortals better.

She gained notoriety as the demon who survived fighting the legendary Knight Commander of the Fifth Crusade multiple times. Her losses were no longer embarrassments as they became the source of her notoriety in a new level of the Abyss.

52cf9efdb6b9447a8c0e52e314fec722.original_text: One day Minagho vanished from the Abyss along with her second in command, Chivarro. They were last seen together speaking in hushed tones. Immediately after their disappearances, rumors spread that some had overheard the words 'love' and 'escape' during that last whispered conversation. Interest in their fate waned however as everyone assumed they had killed each other in a pair of schemes that went awry.
